vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/flashmla_sparse.py:
    def supports_compute_capability(cls, capability):
        return capability.major in [9, 10]

The hardware-specific FlashInfer sparse implementation targets newer GPUs only.
Dense TRITON_MLA is not sparse and fails use_sparse compatibility matching.
Conclusion: SM86 has no official sparse MLA backend at this source pin.
